headline: Community Sailing Center's Kayak and Paddle Park project and recommendations on streamlining city event processes.
summary: The committee will hear a presentation on the Community Sailing Center's Community Kayak and Paddle Park project and discuss recommendations for streamlining city processes for outside groups creating and hosting events.
